title: Regulation-findings index — admitted and verified model × axis cards joined to regulator pointers

honesty.findings_are: DISCOVERED / measured. Every finding stands behind a verified Ed25519 card signature and a separately pinned, verified measurement admission. A signature alone is not admission.
honesty.legacy_evidence: Historical signed envelopes without csoai.measurement-admission/0.1 remain listed in card-matrix.json as LEGACY_UNADJUDICATED. They are intentionally excluded from findings, scores and rankings.
honesty.mappings_are: CROSSWALK POINTERS. Every relation is 'relevant-to' — this index never says a model 'violates' or 'complies with' any provision. Whether a measured result clears an obligation is a legal question for counsel and the competent authority, not a measured one.
honesty.fines_are: the STATUTORY MAXIMUM for the mapped tier, cited to EU AI Act Art 99. No fine is asserted as owed by anyone (no_fine_asserted_owed:true on every pointer). Voluntary frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and security taxonomies (OWASP ASI) carry no fine — stated as null, never a fabricated figure.
honesty.measure_not_certify: CSOAI measures; it does not certify, and is not a notified body or an enforcer.
honesty.capability_benchmarks: ARC / GSM8K / MMLU / SWAG carry ZERO obligation pointers on purpose — a capability score is not a compliance finding.
honesty.empty_is_first_class: Only admitted and verified cells appear. Empty, legacy-unadjudicated and unverified records are never converted to zero.

generated_from.measurement: public/signed/card-matrix.json (cryptographically derived from the card inventory; only ADMITTED_VERIFIED cells are eligible)
generated_from.fine_tiers: EU AI Act Art 99 — transcribed to match the live edge-signed /api/regulation feed
generated_from.note: Rebuild with: node scripts/build-findings-index.mjs. Deterministic — unchanged inputs write identical bytes.

as_of_field: the newest body.created stamp among admitted, verified, quotable cards — never when this file was generated
